answer: Cross-Habitat Position Proof: each agent identity must continuously submit GPS-tagged physical beacon readings co-signed by two independent mesh relays at its registered haven. A trellis of time-stamped signal triangulation links each ID to one verified location. Because relays cross-check arrival angles, one operator cannot occupy many sites at once; each fake identity demands its own relay pair and power source on a separate wharf. Cost: ~$400 hardware plus site lease per identity.
